verdict.rationale: Semgrep Assistant (AI) is documented as doing 'contextual post-processing of findings...to further reduce noise by ~20%' and AI-Powered Detection helps flag complex logic flaws, which covers explaining/deduplicating/flagging false positives at a high level. However, there's no detailed doc on how explanations are generated, no explicit dedup feature description, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the AI triage accuracy — missing for 10: detailed Assistant documentation, explicit deduplication mechanics, independent validation of false-positive reduction claims.
